## Results

This draft collects three independently audited results for Stanford Question 2.13 (10400035 / AMR-103-0035), in the ordinary unframed smooth ordered fixed-endpoint rational string-link category:

1. The Milnor/free-exterior span fails at (k,n)=(2,2). The intersection with the entire all-length repeated-index Milnor algebra is span_Q{1, linking, linking²}; the first component Conway coefficient is outside M_2(2)+N_2(2).
2. N_n(k)=0 for every k≥2 and 0≤n≤2.
3. N_7(2) contains a nonzero invariant of exact order seven, hence N_n(2)≠0 for every n≥7.

The third proof includes the complete marked free-reversal lemma, with exact outer-boundary agreement, collar correction, tube filling, and relative-ball isotopy. It then uses the ordinary rational Duzhin–Karev v5 theorem and weight-system integration. The result is existential; no named nonsingular-link numeric value is claimed.

## Evidence and attribution

The package preserves all authored mathematics in the three full proofs, four supporting lemmas, three independent whole-proof audits, the separate written algebra audit, and two bounded literature/context reviews. Only documented provenance/privacy and unavailable-artifact edits are made. The original source reports are unchanged.

Principal established ingredients are Meilhan’s ordinary degree-two classification; repeated-index Milnor concordance invariance; Nogueira’s free tangle; Kauffman–Lambropoulou’s rational-tangle construction; Willerton’s Conway normalization; classical genus-two hyperelliptic extension/centrality; Hatcher’s relative-ball theorem; and Duzhin–Karev’s ordinary unframed rational degree-seven orientation detector. Public citations, exact editions, access limits, and historical inspection records are retained.

These are AI mathematical audits, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification. No novelty or earliest-priority claim is made.

## Theoretical edition and remaining scope

No executable scripts, fixtures, computational result files, or logs are included. Historical computational passages remain identified as supplementary prior-audit accounts, not checks rerun for this edition. Existing mathematical calculations, including the degree-seven trace polynomial and integer-matrix example, are preserved as authored exposition. No executable check was rewritten into prose to replace an omitted artifact.

Orders three through six on two strands remain unresolved, as do general higher-strand higher-order kernels and general classifications. There is no least-order claim or extension of the order-two spanning failure to all larger orders. The campaign stopped after 3 of 5 approaches; two remain unused and no further approach was spent on packaging.

## Exact file scope

Add only the nineteen files listed below under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10400035/. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file is changed. No copied third-party source body, dataset content, private source, private coordination material, or mixed private artifact inventory is included. SOURCES.json records sixteen public PDF identities locally rechecked for this edition, without source bodies. The noncircular manifest hashes the eighteen other files; its own identity is pinned below.
